# Comprehensive LLM Guidelines for Angular Development

## Advanced Angular Patterns

### State Management Patterns

#### RxJS-Based State Management
```typescript
// Recommended: BehaviorSubject for simple state
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class StateService {
  private state$ = new BehaviorSubject<AppState>(initialState);

  getState(): Observable<AppState> {
    return this.state$.asObservable();
  }

  updateState(updates: Partial<AppState>): void {
    this.state$.next({ ...this.state$.value, ...updates });
  }
}

// For complex state: Use NgRx or similar
// Avoid: Manual subscription management without cleanup
```

#### Component State Patterns
```typescript
// Recommended: Local component state with OnPush
@Component({
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush
})
export class MyComponent {
  private destroy$ = new Subject<void>();

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.dataService.getData()
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe(data => this.handleData(data));
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }
}
```

### Advanced Component Patterns

#### Smart vs Presentational Components
```typescript
// Smart Component (Container)
@Component({
  selector: 'app-user-list',
  template: `
    <app-user-card
      *ngFor="let user of users$ | async; trackBy: trackByUserId"
      [user]="user"
      (userSelected)="onUserSelected($event)">
    </app-user-card>
  `
})
export class UserListComponent {
  users$ = this.userService.getUsers();

  trackByUserId = (index: number, user: User): number => user.id;
}

// Presentational Component (Dumb)
@Component({
  selector: 'app-user-card',
  template: `<div>{{ user.name }}</div>`
})
export class UserCardComponent {
  @Input() user!: User;
  @Output() userSelected = new EventEmitter<User>();
}
```

#### Advanced Lifecycle Management
```typescript
// Recommended: Comprehensive lifecycle management
@Component({
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush
})
export class AdvancedComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy, OnChanges {
  private readonly destroy$ = new Subject<void>();
  private readonly data$ = new BehaviorSubject<Data[]>([]);

  @Input() set config(value: Config) {
    if (value) {
      this.loadData(value);
    }
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.setupSubscriptions();
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['config'] && !changes['config'].firstChange) {
      this.handleConfigChange(changes['config'].currentValue);
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  private setupSubscriptions(): void {
    this.data$
      .pipe(
        takeUntil(this.destroy$),
        debounceTime(300),
        distinctUntilChanged()
      )
      .subscribe(data => this.processData(data));
  }
}
```

## Advanced TypeScript Patterns

### Type Safety Patterns

#### Strict Type Definitions
```typescript
// Recommended: Strict interface definitions
interface User {
  readonly id: number;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: UserRole;
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt?: Date;
}

type UserRole = 'admin' | 'user' | 'moderator';

// Avoid: Loose typing
interface BadUser {
  id: any;
  name: string;
  [key: string]: any; // Avoid index signatures without constraints
}
```

#### Advanced Generic Patterns
```typescript
// Recommended: Constrained generics
interface ApiResponse<T> {
  data: T;
  message: string;
  success: boolean;
  timestamp: Date;
}

interface PaginatedResponse<T> extends ApiResponse<T[]> {
  pagination: {
    page: number;
    limit: number;
    total: number;
    totalPages: number;
  };
}

// Service with proper typing
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ApiService {
  get<T>(endpoint: string): Observable<ApiResponse<T>> {
    return this.http.get<ApiResponse<T>>(`${this.baseUrl}/${endpoint}`);
  }

  getPaginated<T>(endpoint: string, page: number, limit: number): Observable<PaginatedResponse<T>> {
    return this.http.get<PaginatedResponse<T>>(`${this.baseUrl}/${endpoint}`, {
      params: { page: page.toString(), limit: limit.toString() }
    });
  }
}
```

#### Utility Type Patterns
```typescript
// Recommended: Proper use of utility types
type CreateUserRequest = Omit<User, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>;
type UpdateUserRequest = Partial<Omit<User, 'id' | 'createdAt'>>;
type UserSummary = Pick<User, 'id' | 'name' | 'role'>;

// Advanced utility type patterns
type DeepPartial<T> = {
  [P in keyof T]?: T[P] extends object ? DeepPartial<T[P]> : T[P];
};

type RequiredFields<T, K extends keyof T> = T & Required<Pick<T, K>>;
```

## Performance Optimization Patterns

### Advanced Change Detection

#### OnPush Strategy Implementation
```typescript
// Recommended: Proper OnPush implementation
@Component({
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush
})
export class OptimizedComponent {
  @Input() data!: Data[];
  @Output() dataChange = new EventEmitter<Data[]>();

  // Use immutable updates
  updateData(newData: Data): void {
    const updatedData = this.data.map(item =>
      item.id === newData.id ? newData : item
    );
    this.dataChange.emit(updatedData);
  }

  // Use trackBy for performance
  trackByFn = (index: number, item: Data): number => item.id;
}
```

#### Advanced RxJS Patterns
```typescript
// Recommended: Optimized RxJS usage
@Component({
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush
})
export class RxJSComponent {
  private searchTerm$ = new Subject<string>();

  filteredData$ = this.searchTerm$.pipe(
    debounceTime(300),
    distinctUntilChanged(),
    switchMap(term => this.dataService.search(term)),
    catchError(error => {
      console.error('Search error:', error);
      return of([]);
    }),
    shareReplay(1)
  );

  constructor(private dataService: DataService) {}

  onSearch(term: string): void {
    this.searchTerm$.next(term);
  }
}
```

### Memory Management Patterns

#### Advanced Subscription Management
```typescript
// Recommended: Comprehensive subscription management
@Component({
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush
})
export class MemorySafeComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  private readonly destroy$ = new Subject<void>();
  private readonly data$ = new BehaviorSubject<Data[]>([]);

  // Use takeUntil for all subscriptions
  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.dataService.getData()
      .pipe(
        takeUntil(this.destroy$),
        retry(3),
        catchError(error => {
          this.handleError(error);
          return EMPTY;
        })
      )
      .subscribe(data => this.data$.next(data));
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  // Alternative: Use async pipe when possible
  get displayData$(): Observable<Data[]> {
    return this.data$.asObservable();
  }
}
```

## Advanced Error Handling Patterns

### Global Error Handling
```typescript
// Recommended: Comprehensive error interceptor
@Injectable()
export class GlobalErrorInterceptor implements HttpInterceptor {
  constructor(
    private errorService: ErrorService,
    private router: Router
  ) {}

  intercept(req: HttpRequest<any>, next: HttpHandler): Observable<HttpEvent<any>> {
    return next.handle(req).pipe(
      catchError((error: HttpErrorResponse) => {
        let errorMessage = 'An error occurred';

        if (error.error instanceof ErrorEvent) {
          // Client-side error
          errorMessage = `Error: ${error.error.message}`;
        } else {
          // Server-side error
          switch (error.status) {
            case 401:
              this.router.navigate(['/login']);
              errorMessage = 'Authentication required';
              break;
            case 403:
              errorMessage = 'Access denied';
              break;
            case 404:
              errorMessage = 'Resource not found';
              break;
            case 500:
              errorMessage = 'Server error';
              break;
            default:
              errorMessage = `Error Code: ${error.status}\nMessage: ${error.message}`;
          }
        }

        this.errorService.showError(errorMessage);
        return throwError(() => new Error(errorMessage));
      })
    );
  }
}
```

### Component-Level Error Handling
```typescript
// Recommended: Component error boundaries
@Component({
  selector: 'app-error-boundary',
  template: `
    <ng-container *ngIf="!hasError; else errorTemplate">
      <ng-content></ng-content>
    </ng-container>
    <ng-template #errorTemplate>
      <div class="error-container">
        <h3>Something went wrong</h3>
        <p>{{ errorMessage }}</p>
        <button (click)="retry()">Retry</button>
      </div>
    </ng-template>
  `
})
export class ErrorBoundaryComponent {
  @Input() errorMessage = 'An unexpected error occurred';
  @Output() retryRequest = new EventEmitter<void>();

  hasError = false;

  @HostListener('error')
  onError(): void {
    this.hasError = true;
  }

  retry(): void {
    this.hasError = false;
    this.retryRequest.emit();
  }
}
```

## Advanced Testing Patterns

### Comprehensive Unit Testing
```typescript
// Recommended: Comprehensive component testing
describe('UserComponent', () => {
  let component: UserComponent;
  let fixture: ComponentFixture<UserComponent>;
  let userService: jasmine.SpyObj<UserService>;
  let router: jasmine.SpyObj<Router>;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    const userServiceSpy = jasmine.createSpyObj('UserService', ['getUser', 'updateUser']);
    const routerSpy = jasmine.createSpyObj('Router', ['navigate']);

    await TestBed.configureTestingModule({
      imports: [UserComponent],
      providers: [
        { provide: UserService, useValue: userServiceSpy },
        { provide: Router, useValue: routerSpy }
      ]
    }).compileComponents();

    fixture = TestBed.createComponent(UserComponent);
    component = fixture.componentInstance;
    userService = TestBed.inject(UserService) as jasmine.SpyObj<UserService>;
    router = TestBed.inject(Router) as jasmine.SpyObj<Router>;
  });

  it('should load user data on init', () => {
    const mockUser: User = { id: 1, name: 'Test User', email: 'test@example.com' };
    userService.getUser.and.returnValue(of(mockUser));

    component.ngOnInit();

    expect(userService.getUser).toHaveBeenCalledWith(1);
    expect(component.user).toEqual(mockUser);
  });

  it('should handle error when loading user', () => {
    const error = new Error('User not found');
    userService.getUser.and.returnValue(throwError(() => error));

    component.ngOnInit();

    expect(component.error).toBeTruthy();
    expect(component.loading).toBeFalse();
  });
});
```

### Integration Testing Patterns
```typescript
// Recommended: Integration testing with TestBed
describe('UserModule Integration', () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await TestBed.configureTestingModule({
      imports: [UserModule, HttpClientTestingModule],
      providers: [
        { provide: 'API_BASE_URL', useValue: 'http://localhost:3000' }
      ]
    }).compileComponents();
  });

  it('should handle complete user workflow', fakeAsync(() => {
    const fixture = TestBed.createComponent(UserListComponent);
    const component = fixture.componentInstance;

    // Simulate user interaction
    component.onUserSelect(1);
    tick();

    expect(component.selectedUser).toBeDefined();
    expect(component.selectedUser?.id).toBe(1);
  }));
});
```

## Security Patterns

### Input Validation and Sanitization
```typescript
// Recommended: Comprehensive input validation
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ValidationService {
  validateEmail(email: string): boolean {
    const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
    return emailRegex.test(email);
  }

  sanitizeInput(input: string): string {
    return DOMPurify.sanitize(input, { ALLOWED_TAGS: [], ALLOWED_ATTR: [] });
  }

  validateUserInput(userData: CreateUserRequest): ValidationResult {
    const errors: string[] = [];

    if (!this.validateEmail(userData.email)) {
      errors.push('Invalid email format');
    }

    if (userData.name.length < 2) {
      errors.push('Name must be at least 2 characters');
    }

    return {
      isValid: errors.length === 0,
      errors
    };
  }
}
```

### XSS Prevention
```typescript
// Recommended: Safe content rendering
@Component({
  selector: 'app-safe-content',
  template: `
    <div [innerHTML]="sanitizedContent"></div>
  `
})
export class SafeContentComponent {
  @Input() set content(value: string) {
    this.sanitizedContent = this.sanitizer.bypassSecurityTrustHtml(value);
  }

  sanitizedContent: SafeHtml = '';

  constructor(private sanitizer: DomSanitizer) {}
}
```

## Accessibility Patterns

### Advanced ARIA Implementation
```typescript
// Recommended: Comprehensive accessibility
@Component({
  selector: 'app-accessible-modal',
  template: `
    <div
      class="modal-overlay"
      role="dialog"
      [attr.aria-labelledby]="titleId"
      [attr.aria-describedby]="descriptionId"
      [attr.aria-modal]="true"
      (keydown.escape)="close()">

      <div class="modal-content" role="document">
        <h2 [id]="titleId">{{ title }}</h2>
        <p [id]="descriptionId">{{ description }}</p>
        <button (click)="close()" aria-label="Close modal">×</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `
})
export class AccessibleModalComponent {
  @Input() title = '';
  @Input() description = '';
  @Output() closed = new EventEmitter<void>();

  titleId = `modal-title-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
  descriptionId = `modal-description-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;

  close(): void {
    this.closed.emit();
  }
}
```

### Focus Management
```typescript
// Recommended: Proper focus management
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class FocusService {
  private focusableElements = 'button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';

  trapFocus(element: HTMLElement): void {
    const focusableContent = element.querySelectorAll(this.focusableElements);
    const firstFocusableElement = focusableContent[0] as HTMLElement;
    const lastFocusableElement = focusableContent[focusableContent.length - 1] as HTMLElement;

    element.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Tab') {
        if (e.shiftKey) {
          if (document.activeElement === firstFocusableElement) {
            lastFocusableElement.focus();
            e.preventDefault();
          }
        } else {
          if (document.activeElement === lastFocusableElement) {
            firstFocusableElement.focus();
            e.preventDefault();
          }
        }
      }
    });
  }
}
```

## Anti-Patterns to Avoid

### Performance Anti-Patterns
```typescript
// ❌ Avoid: Complex calculations in templates
template: `
  <div *ngFor="let item of items">
    {{ complexCalculation(item) }} <!-- Expensive operation in template -->
  </div>
`

// ✅ Recommended: Use pure pipes or computed properties
template: `
  <div *ngFor="let item of items">
    {{ item | complexCalculation }}
  </div>
`

// ❌ Avoid: Manual subscription management without cleanup
ngOnInit() {
  this.dataService.getData().subscribe(data => {
    this.data = data; // Memory leak potential
  });
}

// ✅ Recommended: Proper cleanup
ngOnInit() {
  this.dataService.getData()
    .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
    .subscribe(data => {
      this.data = data;
    });
}
```

### Type Safety Anti-Patterns
```typescript
// ❌ Avoid: Loose typing
interface BadInterface {
  data: any;
  [key: string]: any;
}

// ✅ Recommended: Strict typing
interface GoodInterface {
  data: SpecificType;
  metadata: Record<string, string>;
}

// ❌ Avoid: Ignoring TypeScript errors
// @ts-ignore
const result = someFunction();

// ✅ Recommended: Proper type handling
const result = someFunction() as ExpectedType;
```

### Architecture Anti-Patterns
```typescript
// ❌ Avoid: God components
@Component({
  template: `
    <!-- 500+ lines of template with complex logic -->
  `
})
export class GodComponent {
  // 1000+ lines of component logic
}

// ✅ Recommended: Break into smaller components
@Component({
  template: `
    <app-header></app-header>
    <app-navigation></app-navigation>
    <app-main-content></app-main-content>
    <app-footer></app-footer>
  `
})
export class MainComponent {
  // Minimal logic, delegate to child components
}
```

## Scalability Patterns

### Module Organization
```typescript
// Recommended: Feature-based module organization
@NgModule({
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    SharedModule,
    UserRoutingModule
  ],
  declarations: [
    UserListComponent,
    UserDetailComponent,
    UserFormComponent
  ],
  providers: [
    UserService,
    UserGuard
  ]
})
export class UserModule { }

// Shared module for common functionality
@NgModule({
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    ReactiveFormsModule
  ],
  declarations: [
    LoadingSpinnerComponent,
    ErrorMessageComponent,
    ConfirmDialogComponent
  ],
  exports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    LoadingSpinnerComponent,
    ErrorMessageComponent,
    ConfirmDialogComponent
  ]
})
export class SharedModule { }
```

### Lazy Loading Patterns
```typescript
// Recommended: Proper lazy loading setup
const routes: Routes = [
  {
    path: 'users',
    loadChildren: () => import('./user/user.module').then(m => m.UserModule),
    canActivate: [AuthGuard],
    data: { preload: true }
  },
  {
    path: 'admin',
    loadChildren: () => import('./admin/admin.module').then(m => m.AdminModule),
    canActivate: [AuthGuard, AdminGuard]
  }
];

// Preloading strategy
@NgModule({
  imports: [
    RouterModule.forRoot(routes, {
      preloadingStrategy: PreloadAllModules
    })
  ],
  exports: [RouterModule]
})
export class AppRoutingModule { }
```

This comprehensive guide provides advanced patterns and anti-patterns for building scalable, maintainable Angular applications with proper TypeScript usage, performance optimization, and accessibility compliance.
